description.text: Six children's worth of quiet, which is a particular kind of quiet. Bryn has his boots off and his feet toward the fire; Meg is going through the day's clothes by feel in the low light. Somebody small is awake upstairs and being extremely careful about it.

The loudest house in Hollowbrook, and it is not close. Six children, one room downstairs, and a sleeping loft reached by a ladder that has been repaired more times than the roof it sits under. Reed bundles are stacked against the outside wall in a rank that doubles as a climbing frame, which Meg has stopped forbidding.

options.text: Step back out to the row
